newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Skilled says EPS growth restrained.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Skilled says EPS growth restrained.

text.p: Labour contractor Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Wednesday that earnings per share growth is likely to be restrained because of general margin pressure and one-off costs assocated with market growth.
"These one-off costs will amount to approximately A$800,000 for the first half year," Skilled said in response to a share price query from the Australian Stock Exchange.

"The company understands that several broking analysts have downgraded their full year earnings expectations from their previous estimates, and assumes that to be the cause of the recent reduction in share price."
"Operating profit before abnormals and tax is not expected to vary from the previous corresponding year by more than 15 percent," Skilled said.
"Revenue has continued to grow strongly and the company has a positive outlook for the second half year."
The exchange's share query follows Tuesday's 20 cents fall to A$3.80. On Wednesday, Skilled shares closed five cents lower at A$3.75.
